The available determinant lemma assumes \(i<k\) and a partition \(\mu\) satisfying \(\mu_k>i\ge\mu_{k+1}\), sets \(\ell=\ell(\mu)\), and states \[ s_\mu=\sum_{m=1}^{k}(-1)^{k-m}h_{\mu_m+k-i-m}s_{\mu^{(m)}}, \] where \(1\le m\le k\) and \[ \mu^{(m)}=(\mu_1,\ldots,\mu_{m-1},\widehat{\mu_m}, \mu_{m+1}-1,\ldots,\mu_k-1,i,\mu_{k+1},\ldots,\mu_\ell). \] [source-2@L1697-L1719|claim=formal-document]

groundings.excerpt:
1697: \begin{lemma}
1698: \label{Woo-2nd-lemma}
1699: Let $i < k$, and assume $\mu$ is a partition with
1700: $
1701: \mu_k > i \geq \mu_{k+1},
1702: $
1703: so that the $(i+1)^{st}$ column of the Young diagram for $\mu$ has length $k > i$.
1704: Then
1705: $$
1706: s_\mu = \sum_{m=1}^k (-1)^{k-m} \,\, h_{\mu_m+k-i-m} \,\, s_{\mu^{(m)}},
1707: $$
1708: where for $m=1,2,\ldots,k$ one defines
1709: $$
1710: \mu^{(m)}:=(\mu_1,\mu_2,\ldots,\mu_{m-1},\widehat{\mu_m}, \mu_{m+1}-1,\mu_{m+2}-1,
1711:                \ldots,\mu_k-1,i,\mu_{k+1},\mu_{k+2},\ldots,\mu_{\ell}),
1712: $$
1713: where $\ell:=\ell(\mu)$ and $\widehat{\mu_m}$ refers to the deletion of
1714: the entry $\mu_m$.
1715: %
1716: %In particular, for each $m=1,2,\ldots,k$ in the sum, the
1717: %factor $h_{\mu_m+k-i-m}$ has positive degree (since $\mu_m \geq i+1$), 
1718: %and each $\lambda^{(m)}$ also has $\lambda^{(m)}_j \geq i$.
1719: \end{lemma}

claims.text: Its bordered matrix is ordered by inserting the row \[ (h_{i-k+1},h_{i-k+2},\ldots,h_{i-k+\ell}) \] between original Jacobi–Trudi rows \(k\) and \(k+1\), then appending column \(\ell+1\), a duplicate of original column \(k-i\). Thus rows are \(1,\ldots,k,\mathrm{new},k+1,\ldots,\ell\), and columns are \(1,\ldots,\ell,\mathrm{duplicate}\). [source-2@L1721-L1730|claim=formal-document]
